text:
invoice-bot: Invoice #INV-2026-044 placed on HOLD: vendor EIN mismatch detected (system compare failed). Reason: tax info mismatch.
sam_finance: FYI holding GoodHope Labs invoice for $18,750 — vendor claims 501(c)(3) exemption but EIN on invoice doesn't match our vendor record. Can someone confirm docs needed to clear?
lee_ops: I pulled the vendor profile — vendor record EIN = 12-3456789, invoice lists EIN = 12-34567890 (extra digit). Looks like a typo.
kate_tax: If they are claiming tax-exempt nonprofit status we need either: a) Signed W-9 with the correct EIN (for payables), or b) IRS determination letter showing 501(c)(3) status, plus the state sales tax exemption certificate if they want sales tax removed.
sam_finance: Great — can we ask them to either reissue invoice with corrected EIN or provide the W-9 + IRS letter? We can't process payment while hold is on.
ana_goodhope: hi everyone — ana from GoodHope Labs here. Sorry about the typo, our accounting team exported the EIN wrong. We can: 1) upload a corrected invoice, 2) attach a signed W-9, and 3) include the IRS determination letter. Which combo do you prefer?
sam_finance: Thanks Ana. Either reissued invoice with corrected EIN + signed W-9 is fine. IRS letter helps speed exemption confirmation if we need to remove tax. For now we can process net amount if paperwork arrives.
kate_tax: Also need the vendor to confirm they are not an S-corp/LLC taxed as corp/other — determination letter will show classification. If they want sales tax refunded we need the state certificate for the relevant state.
ana_goodhope: copy. i'll get the signed W-9 and IRS letter scanned and send both. reissuing invoice now — new invoice will be INV-2026-044A and will show EIN 12-3456789. expect in next 2 hours.
lee_ops: once we have files, i'll manually verify EIN in our vendor record and update if needed, then release hold. Sam — do you want to route payment to the same PO/GL?
sam_finance: yes same PO 3247 and GL 5200. mark as pending release after docs.
kate_tax: quick note: if their W-9 is unsigned we need a wet signature or e-sign that meets IRS standards. Scans are ok if signed.
ana_goodhope: got it — signed e-sig will be included. sending bundle in this thread when uploaded.
invoice-bot: Reminder: policy requires vendor tax docs attached to the invoice record before payment release. I will auto-release hold once attachments are present and EIN verified (manual override allowed by finance).
sam_finance: thanks. tagging @ana_goodhope — please drop the files here (or email ap@redwood.com) and confirm when done.
ana_goodhope: just uploaded: 1) INV-2026-044A.pdf (corrected invoice) 2) GoodHope_W9_signed.pdf 3) IRS_determination_2015.pdf. Link: https://files.goodhope.example/release_bundle.zip
lee_ops: I verified EIN in the W-9 matches vendor profile now. leaving a comment on vendor record. Moving to release queue.
sam_finance: releasing hold and routing payment for next run. kate, if you want to confirm exemption status for our tax records, feel free to flag any follow-ups.
kate_tax: I'll log the determination letter in the tax folder and add a note about state exemption not claimed (they didn't provide a state certificate). If they later request a refund for sales tax, we'll need that certificate.
ana_goodhope: thanks everyone — appreciate the quick turnaround. Apologies for the extra digit.
invoice-bot: Invoice #INV-2026-044A: HOLD cleared by sam_finance at 1758890400. Payment scheduled per AP cadence.
